violations: Page 8 disclosure (State Revised Total Coliform Rule): 'Although E.coli was detected during routine sampling, the water system was not in violation of the E.coli MCL. An E.coli MCL violation only occurs if one of the following conditions is met - E.coli-positive repeat sample following TC-positive routine sample, TC-positive repeat sample following an E.coli positive routine sample, failure to collect all required repeat samples following a E.coli-positive routine sample, or failure to test for E.coli when any repeat sample is TC-positive.' (Table 1 nonetheless prints 0 E. coli detections.)

Page 8 disclosure (chromium 6): 'chromium (hexavalent) was detected at levels that exceed the chromium (hexavalent) MCL. While a water system of our size is not considered in violation of the chromium (hexavalent) MCL until after October 1st, 2028, we are working to address this exceedance and comply with the MCL. Specifically, we are conducting quarterly Chromium-6 sampling to monitor the contamination, and are investigating possible feasible treatment options to comply with the MCL compliance date.' (Table 4 nonetheless prints 0.25 ppb against the 10 ppb MCL.)
extraction_notes: The district publishes the CCR as an uploaded Word document on Google Docs; the saved PDF is the Google Docs PDF export of that document (title '2025 Aldercroft Height CCR.docx'), so the sha256 is of the export, not an original PDF. State SWS CCR template prepared by Cypress Water Services. Two narrative disclosures on page 8 (E. coli detected; hexavalent chromium exceeding the MCL) contradict the data tables (0 E. coli detections; Cr6 0.25 ppb) and may be template language left in; both are recorded verbatim. Color and manganese are reported separately for pretreatment (raw) and post-treatment water and are stored with source_group. Table 10 turbidity performance standards were left as unfilled template placeholders. Nitrate is from 2024 samples, gross alpha from 2020, post-treatment color from 2019, as printed. 1-based page numbers follow the 'Page N of 9' footers.
